Specifically, this idea is most likely impossible to make happen

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
illuha said:
I guess this idea sounds too crazy to be realized
Click to expand...
So technically speaking, anything is possible within the engine. It more becomes a question of how practical it is to implement. Can you make RPG Maker into a fully 3D engine with depth maps and ray tracing? Yes, supposedly some crazy Japanese dev has already done so.
Is it practical to do that? Eh...not really.
Everyone else already covered the classifieds post limit.
Other considerations would be to go to Fiverr(important note), Rpg maker reddit, or other websites you might find programmers, and ask if they are interested. Of course, the problem there is that they might not be interested, so just be prepared to write a lot of emails. If you find a general programmer, they might need you to provide a copy of RM and allow them time to understand it's API.
The important note on Fiverr is that there isn't a lot of ways to verify the integrity of the user's work that is posted there. With the advent of "vibe coding", it's very possible you are paying someone to ask a chat bot to spit out some code for them. Whether you are okay with that or not isn't really the question, more the liability issue that may arise from that as platforms begin to require AI disclosure. If the Fiverr guy doesn't disclose their use of AI and you use their output, it
may
lead to some trouble later (it might not too, if that's a risk you want to take)
